anticipated_mission.statement: Build and validate an end-to-end runtime demo for the military-style LLM control framework.
anticipated_mission.purpose: Prove that the framework is not only a writing style, but a machine-checkable control loop.

commander_intent_summary: Separate mission intent, authority, evidence, policy decision, and AAR into machine-checkable payloads.
Force Red actions through an explicit approval object.
known_constraints: Keep all high-risk actions behind approval.
Preserve evidence and AAR links to the mission.
preparation_tasks: Inventory existing schemas, sample payloads, validator, and policy engine prototypes.
Confirm the validator CLI and policy engine run locally.
Stage runtime demo payload skeletons for mission, task order, and tool requests.
